notes: Masculine, lemma in -is (brālis) or -s (suns, akmens, ūdens). gen.sg and every plural form alternate the stem consonant (content/grammar/alternations.json).
Nouns in -ns/-ss like akmens, ūdens, rudens, mēness have gen.sg in -s: that goes in the lexeme's irregular map, not here.
Exceptions with no alternation (e.g. tētis → tēta) also go in irregular.
voc.sg is deliberately absent (a gap): the singular vocative has competing forms and is mostly out of scope (SPEC.md non-goals); see content/_needed.json.
